The '''Sith book of offerings and rituals''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] that purported to discuss the religious rites of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="SOL" /> Between [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] and [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> while searching for information about<ref name="SOL" /> his [[Parent/Legends|mother]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] saw an advertisement for the book in a [[Air taxi/Legends|courtesy cab]] operated by the [[Galactic Archives]], a small shop in [[Trader's Plaza]], [[Talos City|Talos]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]], which took customers to the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant's]] central distribution hub. Other volumes advertised included the [[H'kig book of laws]], ''[[Principles of Power]]'', and a [[The secrets of forming Bilar-type claqa group-minds|publication]] that purported to teach the secrets of forming [[Hive mind/Legends|group minds]] like the [[Bilar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]; the shop promised a discount for the purchase of three or more books. Skywalker discounted the advertised volumes as probable frauds.<ref name="SOL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith book of offerings and rituals was mentioned in ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', the second novel of ''[[The Black Fleet Crisis]]'' trilogy. The novel was written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]] and published in [[1996]].<ref name="SOL" />
